title: Store Update 1.37.0
body:
# Store Update 1.37.0

Raiders!

Store Update 1.37.0 is rolling out now across all platforms, bringing two fresh colour options for the Driftcoat outfit: black/green and red. If you already own this skin, both variants will be added to your account automatically, and no restart is needed.

We're aware of your feedback that the Seeker Grenade has felt less effective since last week's update, and we've been looking into it. We've found that a collision change caused an unintended effect on the projectiles. Our team is now working on a fix, and we'll share an update once it's ready.

We've also noted your reports about being unintentionally enrolled in Departure after completing the "Deal Damage" challenge (hitting 100,000 total damage dealt). This behaviour is not intended, and a fix is being worked on.

Following last week's fix to the duplication glitch, we've continued banning accounts that used the exploit to gain a meaningful advantage. This week's enforcement follows the same approach we used back in February:

* Warnings are being issued for minor cases where the exploit's use was limited.

* Coins and items connected to exploit activity are being removed.

* Suspensions are being handed out for the most serious cases, particularly where the exploit caused significant harm to the in-game economy or negatively affected other players' experience.

Players who used the glitch on purpose but did not gain a substantial advantage from it will not face suspension. If you simply received a small number of items from someone else who was duping, without knowingly taking part in the exploit yourself, you may receive a warning instead.

Our aim is to take action only against those who deliberately and significantly abused the exploit, not to penalise players who were only incidentally involved.

Thank you to everyone who flagged this issue and kept playing by the rules.

See you Topside, //Ossen
